resource.name: sales-entity-service
resource.description: Customers and prospects, their opportunities and the opportunity line items (products) a paid customer engagement is raised from; read only for this product.
resource.provider: the organization's sales entity service, backed by Salesforce

config.description: Client id for the client-credentials grant
Client secret for the client-credentials grant
Token address for the client-credentials grant
Address of the service's GraphQL interface

resource.consumptionInstructions: Authenticate with OAuth2 client credentials against the token address and send the bearer token with every GraphQL request. Four queries: customers(filter, isRealTime, limit, offset) for accounts by status, opportunities(filter, isRealTime, limit, offset) for one customer's opportunities (optionally active only), subscriptionLineItems(filter, limit, offset) for an opportunity's line items by classification, and subscriptionLineItem(id) for one line item's current service dates. Lists are paged by limit and offset and return an empty page when exhausted; page until empty. Pass isRealTime: true on customers and opportunities to read live CRM data. A line item carries the fields a paid engagement copies: the auto engagement code, tentative-dates flag, service start and end dates, product unit and business unit. The service fronts Salesforce; callers never reach Salesforce directly.
